Edibles are weird things. I think a lot of it has to do with how people's bodies handle them differently, digestion is a very complex process and there are a lot of variables there.

I had a wake-up call with this a few years back and I have been careful ever since. I took what should have been a fairly strong, but certainly not crazy dose, from a larger batch that I made for myself. I had a minor buzz about 15 minutes in, and then nothing.

TWO HOURS later - by the clock, not by guessing - I sat down to enjoy some reheated pizza. I was just finishing that first slice when I got more suddenly and profoundly stoned than I thought possible. I was in a safe place and I'm an experienced user so it was a lot of fun - my best memory of it is standing at the sink, washing my hands under the running water, and each of my hands had become a fish, and the two fish were just twisting up against each other and rubbing around. I'm really, really happy I was not walking around in public when it kicked in like that.

Anyway, my assumption is that the edible had just sort of sat there in my stomach, because my digestive system just wasn't very active at the time I happened to take my dose. Once I started to dig into my pizza, everything kicked in - and the edibles, still in my stomach, happened to be processed in just the optimal way, ready to be quickly absorbed in my gut. Eating a little earlier might have slowed the effects, and eating later might have meant that the useful chemicals had already been broken down. Thats just a guess, but like I said, they vary a lot even for the same person, so they probably vary more between people too.

Smoking is pretty self-limiting - the effects hit pretty quickly, and once you get stoned to a certain point, you stop smoking more. Edibles have no ceiling. You can easily pack 20 doses into large cookie and eat it all at once. (The result of this, BTW, is many hours of misery. Don't try it). For someone in your situation, you might never get an effect, or you might only get an effect when certain other variables happen to line up. Rather than trying larger and larger doses, just let it go and stick to smoking and vaping instead.
